library.onnxruntime_web_version: 1.18.0 (dist hard-codes ORT WASM to cdnjs 1.18.0; pin the import map to 1.18.0)

api.list_voices: await tts.voices() -> VoiceMeta[] (fetches voices.json; needs network). Offline-safe: exported PATH_MAP. await tts.stored() -> cached voiceIds[].
api.download_model: await tts.download(voiceId, p => {}) where p = { url, total, loaded } (total from Content-Length; only wired to the .onnx). Also tts.remove(voiceId), tts.flush().
api.synthesize_returns: await tts.predict({text, voiceId}) -> Blob 'audio/x-wav' (mono 16-bit PCM; 22050Hz medium). BASE predict re-parses the 63MB graph EVERY call. Fork adds: const s = await TtsSession.create({voiceId}); const blob = await s.predict(text) — reuses the ONNX session (use this).
api.cache_mechanism: OPFS via navigator.storage.getDirectory() ('piper' dir). Cache write gated on url containing 'https://huggingface.co', so self-hosted files are never cached. Failures are swallowed (console.error only).

library.minimal_example: importmap for onnxruntime-web@1.18.0 is MANDATORY (bare import). Then import * as tts, download if not stored, s=TtsSession.create({voiceId}), blob=s.predict(text), play. iOS needs a user gesture.

voices_note: All English voices ~63MB (low tier gives no size saving; only 16kHz vs 22kHz). Recommended warm defaults: en_US-amy-medium, en_US-hfc_female-medium (README default), en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium (gentlest GB, CC-BY attribution). Models fetched from huggingface.co/diffusionstudio/piper-voices snapshot.

hosting.self_host: No base-path option without editing the dist; runtime CDN is fine. Single-threaded WASM without COOP/COEP (slower but works on any static host).

key_gotchas: Bare import 'onnxruntime-web' -> requires an import map (top failure cause).
Use TtsSession (fork) not base predict, or every phrase re-parses 63MB.
iOS < Safari 26: OPFS createWritable may fail -> model re-downloads each visit (silent).
Audio autoplay: unlock an AudioContext inside the tap, feed decoded PCM when synth resolves.
Inference blocks the thread (freezes animation) -> cache generated clips; a Web Worker is the clean fix.
Some voices carry CC-BY/other licences -> use an explicit allowlist + credit.
